settings.heading: Are your products really 100% natural?
settings.content: Yes. Our formulas use plant and earth ingredients, with no parabens, silicones or sulfates. Every product page lists its full ingredients.

settings.heading: Which face cream should I choose?
settings.content: The Hypoallergenic Facial Cream is for sensitive skin: it’s nut free and fragrance free. The Advanced Hydration Facial Cream is richer, for dry to normal skin. See the side-by-side comparison.

settings.heading: Is the Hypoallergenic Facial Cream nut free?
settings.content: Yes. It uses rice bran oil instead of nut oils, and it’s fragrance free.

settings.heading: Can I return a product?
settings.content: See our Refund Policy, or email info@teraclay.com and we’ll help.
